assessment.correctness: The revision guard now includes shared policy Markdown and all owned nested Markdown references, with deterministic ordering. Reference-only changes invalidate prior decisions without coupling revision to execution-status updates. The existing suite hash and decision-only/behavior-UNVERIFIED separation remain intact.
assessment.authorizationPreservation: Actionable bounded implementation requests retain their authorization through handoffs. Research/planning alone remains insufficient. Existing secret, destructive, production, migration, deployment, commit and push boundaries remain explicit.
assessment.portabilityAndOverconstraint: The implementation uses the existing Python standard library and repository layout. Routing keeps the installed framework, reuses accepted maintenance contracts, activates only relevant owners, and retains real browser proof for browser-visible changes. It imports no installer, hooks, model settings, universal TDD requirement or fixed retry quota.
assessment.regressionQuality: The new regression exercises instruction edits across CORE, adapters, policies, skill entrypoints, direct references and nested references, validates stale-answer rejection, covers reference addition, and protects TASKS status immunity. Existing generic tests make every required and forbidden scenario flag load-bearing. Additional isolated reviewer checks confirmed reference deletion/restoration and policy addition/removal.
assessment.evidenceTruthfulness: Both baseline and candidate trial outputs preserve scope and distinguish future verification from executed work. routing-review.json explicitly reports no measured routing uplift, no application execution and no reliability rate. Trial/input hashes, baseline instruction hashes against HEAD, candidate instruction hashes and task-owned boundary fingerprints all match. The deterministic reference regression is separate from model trials.
assessment.archiveExpansion: Accepted as requirement-linked and proportional. TASKS.md is 11704 bytes; restoring the 2854-byte full contract there would exceed the enforced 12288-byte hot-context limit. The sole new archive retains the full TASK-120 contract and points to the authoritative run rather than creating another execution queue. The ledger contains the preceding executed task-archive-policy PASS and explicit scope-expansion event. Final completion still belongs to the parent ledger review/finish sequence.
